FEAT-3-S63.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
FEAT-3-S63.description: Integrate and enforce Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs and outputs, ensuring strict validation of condition, location, and response structure before and after service execution.

FEAT-3-S64.title: External API Resilience and Error Handling
FEAT-3-S64.description: Implement retry logic, timeout handling, and graceful degradation for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API calls, ensuring partial results can still be returned when one dependency fails.

FEAT-3-S65.title: EvaluateCare Facade End-to-End Integration for Trials
FEAT-3-S65.description: Wire clinical trials search flow through EvaluateCare facade, ensuring orchestration from validated input → service calls → enrichment → formatted response is executed as a single cohesive operation.

FEAT-3-S66.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S66.description: Create unit tests for query construction, location extraction, and distance computation, plus integration tests validating full flow from tool invocation to formatted response output.
